body.statement: The following are equivalent: \(L=U\); every even alternating cycle \(c_1,x_1,\ldots,c_q,x_q,c_1\) in \(E_+\) satisfies \(\sum_{j=1}^q(\mu_{c_jx_j}-\mu_{c_{j+1}x_j})=0\), where \(c_{q+1}=c_1\); and each connected component of \(E_+\) admits potentials \(a_c,b_x\) with \(\mu_{cx}=a_c+b_x\) on every effective edge.
body.justification: This supporting lemma gives the exact support-aware diagnostic for when the selector envelope collapses.
body.gap: The alternating-cycle criterion is classical transport geometry and is not the headline contribution.
body.consumer: An analyst can determine whether missing joint allocation matters before reporting bounds.
